basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old podcast enthusiast from Austin, Texas. Recently discovered the world of Reddit and instantly got hooked on discussions about media and entertainment. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a flexible schedule to browse Reddit during the day and late at night. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my downtime exploring indie video games and learning new design techniques. I dislike overly aggressive debates and prefer communities that foster positive interactions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having completed a bachelor's degree in visual arts. Over the years, I've honed my skills through various online courses and freelance projects. Recently, I've taken an interest in audio editing, learning through YouTube tutorials and trial and error.
